lessons.name: lead_de5612a2
lessons.why: The 42-state paired walk: the pair repeats for every n; it first returns to (1,1) at step 42; it visits all 42 states within one period; and it passes through the two contact points (8,1) at step 21 and (1,1) at step 42. -/ def lead_de5612a2 : Prop := (∀ n : Nat, 2 ^ (n + 42) % 9 = 2 ^ n % 9 ∧ (1 + 2 * (n + 42)) % 7 = (1 + 2 * n) % 7) ∧ ((List.range 42).all (fun n => n == 0 || !((2 ^ n % 9 == 1) && ((1 + 2 * n) % 7 == 1)))) = true ∧ ([1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5].all (fun x => (List.range 7).all (fun y => (List.range 42).any (fun n => (2 ^ n % 9 == x) && ((1 + 2 * n) % 7 == y))))) = true ∧ ((2 ^ 21 % 9 == 8) && ((1 + 2 * 21) % 7 == 1)) = true ∧ ((2 ^ 42 % 9 == 1) && ((1 + 2 * 42) % 7 == 1)) = true -- @skill: vortex /-- The kernel proves lead de5612a2: the uncapped period for every n, and the finite parts over their ranges. — the definitions it rests on are Lean 4 core's (de Moura and Ullrich 2021, doi 10.1007/978-3-030-79876-5_37), which a stranger can read
